description: Nihonium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Nh and atomic number 113. It is extremely radioactive, with its most stable known isotope, nihonium-286, having a half-life of about 10 seconds. In the periodic table, it is a transactinide element in the p-block, belonging to period 7 and group 13.
characteristics: Nihonium has been calculated to have similar properties to boron, aluminium, gallium, indium, and thallium, and is expected to be a post-transition metal. It should be more stable in the +1 oxidation state than the +3 state, like thallium, but in the +1 state should behave more like silver and astatine. Preliminary experiments have shown that elemental nihonium is not very volatile and is less reactive than its lighter homologue thallium.
